title: Partners API
description: The Partners API lets a Surfboard partner manage the merchants, users, and analytics that sit under their partner account. Look up partner details and configuration, pull partner, transaction and application analytics, search across everything a partner owns, look up companies during onboarding, and list and update users.

apis.heading: Get Partner Details
apis.description: Retrieve the core details of a partner account, including its onboarding URL, supported billing plans, enabled payment methods, and the acquirer configured for each country the partner operates in.

reqParams.name: partnerId
reqParams.description: Identifier of the partner to fetch details for. Supplied in the URL path.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The partner account details.

resParams.name: partnerId
resParams.description: Unique identifier of the partner.

resParams.name: webOnboardingUrl
resParams.description: Hosted URL where the partner's merchants complete web-based onboarding.

resParams.name: partnerName
resParams.description: Display name of the partner.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Lifecycle status of the partner account, for example ACTIVE.

resParams.name: supportedBillingPlans
resParams.description: Billing plans the partner is allowed to assign to its merchants.

resParams.name: partnerType
resParams.description: Type of partner, which determines the onboarding and billing flow available to it.

resParams.name: paymentMethods
resParams.description: Payment methods enabled for the partner, for example CARD or SWISH.

resParams.name: countryCode
resParams.description: Primary country the partner is registered in (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

resParams.name: acquirerConfig
resParams.description: The acquirer used to process card payments, per operating country.

resParams.name: country
resParams.description: Country the acquirer applies to (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

resParams.name: acquirer
resParams.description: Name of the acquirer that settles card payments in this country.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

reqParams.name: partnerId
reqParams.description: Identifier of the partner to fetch configuration for. Supplied in the URL path.

resParams.name: status

resParams.name: data

resParams.name: activateTerminalFromPortal

resParams.name: allowAdvancedOnboarding

resParams.name: enableProductCatalogueInOnboarding

resParams.name: ecrEnabled

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Get Transaction Analytics
apis.description: Retrieve aggregated transaction analytics across the partner's merchants. Narrow the results with filters such as store, terminal, payment method, card brand, or date range, and group the totals by one or more dimensions to build reporting dashboards.
apis.query: Page through results with the `x-page-number` request header. The total number of matching rows is returned in the `x-total-items` response header. Grouping is controlled with bracketed query keys, for example `groupBy[storeId]=true` or `groupBy[timeSegments]=DAILY`.

reqParams.name: partnerId
reqParams.description: Identifier of the partner to fetch analytics for. Supplied in the URL path.

reqParams.name: merchantId
reqParams.description: Return only analytics for this merchant under the partner.

reqParams.name: storeId
reqParams.description: Return only analytics for transactions at this store.

reqParams.name: terminalId
reqParams.description: Return only analytics for transactions processed by this terminal.

reqParams.name: startDate
reqParams.description: Start of the date range to aggregate over (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-06-01).

reqParams.name: endDate
reqParams.description: End of the date range to aggregate over (ISO 8601).

reqParams.name: orderType
reqParams.description: Return only analytics for this order type.

reqParams.name: terminalType
reqParams.description: Return only analytics for this terminal type.

reqParams.name: paymentMethod
reqParams.description: Return only analytics for this payment method, for example CARD or SWISH.

reqParams.name: cardBrand
reqParams.description: Return only analytics for this card brand, for example VISA or MASTERCARD.

reqParams.name: currency
reqParams.description: Return only analytics in this currency (ISO 4217 code).

reqParams.name: includeRealtimeTransactions
reqParams.description: When true, includes transactions that have not yet settled in the aggregation.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The aggregated analytics rows, one per grouping bucket.

resParams.name: storeId
resParams.description: Store the row is grouped by. Present only when grouping by store.

resParams.name: terminalId
resParams.description: Terminal the row is grouped by. Present only when grouping by terminal.

resParams.name: orderType
resParams.description: Order type the row is grouped by. Present only when grouping by order type.

resParams.name: terminalType
resParams.description: Terminal type the row is grouped by. Present only when grouping by terminal type.

resParams.name: orderTransactionCount
resParams.description: Number of transactions in this grouping bucket.

resParams.name: totalTransactionAmount
resParams.description: Total transaction value for this bucket, in the smallest unit of the currency (e.g. öre for SEK).

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Get Application Analytics
apis.description: Retrieve aggregated merchant onboarding analytics for the partner, such as application counts by status, conversion and rejection rates, and merchants created. Filter by country, application type, or status group, choose a time frame, and group by dimensions like country or month for onboarding reporting.
apis.query: Page through results with the `x-page-number` request header. The total number of matching rows is returned in the `x-total-items` response header. List filters use bracket notation, for example `filters[countries]=SE&filters[countries]=NO`.

reqParams.name: partnerId
reqParams.description: Identifier of the partner to fetch onboarding analytics for. Supplied in the URL path.

reqParams.name: timeFrame
reqParams.description: Preset time window to aggregate over. Use CUSTOM together with dateFrom and dateTo for an explicit range.

reqParams.name: dateFrom
reqParams.description: Start of a custom date range (ISO 8601). Used when timeFrame is CUSTOM.

reqParams.name: dateTo
reqParams.description: End of a custom date range (ISO 8601). Used when timeFrame is CUSTOM.

reqParams.name: groupBy
reqParams.description: One or more dimensions to group the results by.

reqParams.name: filters[countries]
reqParams.description: Return only applications for these countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes).

reqParams.name: filters[applicationTypes]
reqParams.description: Return only applications of these types.

reqParams.name: filters[statusGroup]
reqParams.description: Return only applications in this status group.

reqParams.name: sortBy
reqParams.description: Field to sort the grouped rows by.

reqParams.name: sortOrder
reqParams.description: Sort direction for the results.

reqParams.name: pageNumber
reqParams.description: Page of results to return. Overrides the x-page-number header when supplied.

reqParams.name: itemsPerPage
reqParams.description: Number of rows to return per page.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The aggregated onboarding analytics.

resParams.name: applicationAnalyticsData
resParams.description: The grouped analytics rows.

resParams.name: country
resParams.description: Country the row is grouped by. Present only when grouping by country.

resParams.name: applicationType
resParams.description: Application type the row is grouped by. Present only when grouping by application type.

resParams.name: statusGroup
resParams.description: Status group the row is grouped by. Present only when grouping by status group.

resParams.name: timeSegment
resParams.description: Time bucket the row is grouped by. Present only when grouping by a time dimension.

resParams.name: totalApplications
resParams.description: Total applications in this bucket.

resParams.name: totalInitiated
resParams.description: Applications initiated but not yet submitted in this bucket.

resParams.name: totalExpired
resParams.description: Applications that expired before completion in this bucket.

resParams.name: totalSubmitted
resParams.description: Applications submitted for review in this bucket.

resParams.name: totalPending
resParams.description: Applications awaiting further information in this bucket.

resParams.name: totalSigned
resParams.description: Applications signed in this bucket.

resParams.name: totalRejected
resParams.description: Applications rejected in this bucket.

resParams.name: totalCompleted
resParams.description: Applications that completed onboarding in this bucket.

resParams.name: totalMerchantCreated
resParams.description: Merchants created in this bucket.

resParams.name: totalServiceProviderCreated
resParams.description: Service providers created in this bucket.

resParams.name: conversionRate
resParams.description: Share of applications that completed onboarding, as a percentage.

resParams.name: rejectionRate
resParams.description: Share of applications that were rejected, as a percentage.

resParams.name: expirationRate
resParams.description: Share of applications that expired, as a percentage.

resParams.name: totalCount
resParams.description: Total number of grouped rows across all pages.

resParams.name: pageNumber
resParams.description: The page of results returned.

resParams.name: itemsPerPage
resParams.description: Number of rows returned per page.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Global Search
apis.description: Run a free-text search across everything the partner owns — merchants, stores, terminals, applications, and companies — and get back the matching records grouped by type, along with the fields that matched. Narrow the search with filters such as merchant, store, or status.
apis.query: Page through results with the `x-page-number` request header, or supply `pageNumber` as a query parameter. The total number of matches is returned in the `x-total-items` response header.

reqParams.name: partnerId
reqParams.description: Identifier of the partner whose records are searched. Supplied in the URL path.

reqParams.name: query
reqParams.description: The text to search the partner's records for, such as a merchant name, store name, or company.

reqParams.name: pageNumber
reqParams.description: Page of results to return. Overrides the x-page-number header when supplied.

reqParams.name: merchantId
reqParams.description: Return only records belonging to this merchant. Accepts a single value or a comma-separated list.

reqParams.name: merchantType
reqParams.description: Return only records for merchants of this type. Accepts a single value or a comma-separated list.

reqParams.name: storeId
reqParams.description: Return only records belonging to this store. Accepts a single value or a comma-separated list.

reqParams.name: storeStatus
reqParams.description: Return only stores in this status. Accepts a single value or a comma-separated list.

reqParams.name: terminalStatus
reqParams.description: Return only terminals in this status. Accepts a single value or a comma-separated list.

reqParams.name: applicationStatus
reqParams.description: Return only applications in this status. Accepts a single value or a comma-separated list.

reqParams.name: applicationType
reqParams.description: Return only applications of this type. Accepts a single value or a comma-separated list.

reqParams.name: type
reqParams.description: Return only records of this document type, for example MERCHANT or STORE. Accepts a single value or a comma-separated list.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The search results.

resParams.name: hits
resParams.description: The matching records.

resParams.name: partnerId
resParams.description: Identifier of the partner the matched record belongs to.

resParams.name: merchantId
resParams.description: Identifier of the merchant the matched record belongs to.

resParams.name: storeId
resParams.description: Identifier of the store the matched record belongs to.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The matched record's document fields.

resParams.name: type
resParams.description: The kind of record that matched, for example MERCHANT, STORE, or COMPANY.

resParams.name: partnerId
resParams.description: Identifier of the partner the record belongs to.

resParams.name: merchantId
resParams.description: Identifier of the merchant the record belongs to.

resParams.name: storeId
resParams.description: Identifier of the store the record belongs to.

resParams.name: companyId
resParams.description: Identifier of the company the record belongs to.

resParams.name: pfAccountId
resParams.description: Payment facilitator account identifier for the record.

resParams.name: name
resParams.description: Display name of the matched record.

resParams.name: email
resParams.description: Email associated with the matched record.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the matched record, mirrored from its store status.

resParams.name: storeStatus
resParams.description: Status of the store the record belongs to.

resParams.name: merchantType
resParams.description: Type of the merchant the record belongs to.

resParams.name: matches
resParams.description: The individual field matches for this record.

resParams.name: field
resParams.description: The document field that matched the search.

resParams.name: matched
resParams.description: The matched value or values for the field.

resParams.name: snippet
resParams.description: A snippet of text surrounding the match.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

resParams.name: street

resParams.name: city

resParams.name: telephone

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.
